questions.speaker: tobo
questions.q: Tobo floats in the cabin: "See? No gravity in space!" Is he right?
options: No, gravity is still pulling. We're just falling around Cinder together
questions.misconception: There is no gravity in space.
questions.feedback: Gravity reaches far into space. Astronauts float because they and their ship are falling together, all the time.

questions.speaker: asha
questions.q: If we flew twice as far from Cinder, its pull on us would be…
questions.misconception: Gravity weakens in a straight line with distance.
questions.feedback: Double the distance, a quarter the pull. That's the inverse-square law!

questions.speaker: kiran
questions.misconception: Rock layers have no time order.
questions.feedback: New layers pile on top of old ones, so in undisturbed rock, deeper means older.

questions.speaker: kiran
questions.q: Veil is hotter than the planet closest to its star. Why?
options: Its thick CO₂ air traps heat
questions.misconception: Only distance from the star sets a planet's temperature.
questions.feedback: The air matters as much as the distance. In our Solar System, Venus is hotter than Mercury for the same reason.

questions.speaker: tobo
questions.q: "Greenhouse gases are always bad!" says Tobo. Hmm?
options: No. A little keeps a planet warm enough for life, too much overheats it
questions.feedback: Without any greenhouse effect, Earth would be frozen. It's all about balance.

questions.speaker: asha
questions.q: Why did skimming the haze slow us down?
options: Air pushes back on fast-moving things
questions.feedback: That push-back is drag. Real Mars orbiters used it to save fuel (aerobraking).

questions.speaker: mc1
questions.q: MC-1: "When you look at a star 38 light-years away, you see it…"
options: As it will be in 38 years
questions.misconception: We see stars as they are at this moment.
questions.feedback: Light needs time to travel. Starlight is a message from the past.

questions.speaker: kiran
questions.q: What will our Sun do in about 5 billion years?
options: Swell into a red giant, then shrink to a white dwarf
questions.misconception: All stars explode or become black holes.
questions.feedback: Only very massive stars go supernova. The Sun will become a red giant, then a white dwarf. And 5 billion years is a LONG time.

questions.speaker: tobo
questions.q: To escape a planet using the least fuel, Tobo should burn…
options: In the direction he's already moving
questions.misconception: The best way out is straight up.
questions.feedback: Burning forward adds to the speed you already have. Rockets launch sideways into orbit for the same reason.
